units.source_text: 這與躺在那些白痴妓女的懷中安然酣睡的感覺迥然不同（首先，那些妓女都很開朗快活），

en.t: This was utterly different from the feeling of lying in the arms of those foolish prostitutes and sleeping peacefully and soundly (for one thing, those prostitutes were all bright and cheerful),

units.source_text: 跟這個詐騙犯的妻子度過的一夜，對我來說，是被解放了的幸福之夜（語言如此毫不猶豫地誇張與肯定，在我所有的手記中都是絕無僅有的）。

en.t: the night I spent with this swindler's wife was, for me, a happy night of liberation (in all my notebooks, this is the only place where my language exaggerates and affirms so unhesitatingly).
But it was only that one night.

units.source_text: 當我早晨醒來跳下床，我便又變回了那個淺薄、善於偽裝的搞笑角色。

en.t: When I woke in the morning and jumped out of bed, I turned back into that shallow, practiced clown of a performer.

units.source_text: 膽小鬼連幸福都害怕，碰到棉花都會受傷。

en.t: A coward is afraid even of happiness, and can be wounded by touching cotton.
Sometimes one can be hurt by happiness too.

units.source_text: 趁著自己還沒受傷，我著急儘快與她分手，於是，我又使出了搞笑慣用的花言巧語。

en.t: Before I could be hurt, I anxiously hurried to break things off with her, and so I once again brought out my usual clownish sweet talk.
